name: Mühlheim an der Donau (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Mühlheim an der Donau (a black mill wheel on white).
history: Municipal flag of Mühlheim an der Donau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Mühlheim an der Donau arms — black mill wheel on white
